description:
Speak instead of typing. Native voice dictation for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Dimmy is a cross-platform voice-transcription overlay. Record audio with a global hotkey, transcribe locally (whisper.cpp or Parakeet) or via cloud STT (Groq, OpenAI, Deepgram, Gemini), optionally clean up the text with an LLM, then paste it into the focused app. It also offers command mode (transform selected text in place), meeting recording with an LLM recap, and a custom dictionary.
## What's Changed since `v0.7.1-rc.10`

• fix(win)：the onboarding window ignored the user's theme
• fix(meeting)：show a recap that is already streaming when the window opens
• fix(meeting)：reopening the window shows the conversation so far

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|----------|------|--------------|
| Windows (installer) | `Dimmy-win-Setup.exe` | None (installs .NET 8 automatically) |
| Windows (portable) | `Dimmy-win-Portable.zip` | [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0) |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `Dimmy-macos-arm64.dmg` | macOS 12+ |
| Linux | `Dimmy-linux-x86_64.AppImage` | None (GTK4 bundled) |

## Installation Notes

**Windows:** Download `Dimmy-win-Setup.exe` and run. Installs .NET 8 automatically if needed.

**macOS:** Open the DMG, drag to Applications. First launch：right-click -> Open, or run:
```
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Dimmy.app
```

**Linux:** Make AppImage executable (`chmod +x`) and run.

---
*Check for updates in Dimmy Settings > About.*
